approvalTitle: tasks.md: converting the causal loop diagram to DISL and FBL
content:
# Tasks Document

One Developer owns this specification, per CLAUDE.md's one-owner-per-specification rule, and works it in one worktree (`.claude/worktrees/cld`, branch `features/causal-loop-disl-fbl`). **The order is the design's eight steps and it is load-bearing**: the transcript is frozen before anything changes (task 1), derivation is switched before reading (tasks 5 and 6), and reading before writing (task 7), so that a difference in the transcript can be attributed to one change.

**Every task is one pull request into `develop` and leaves the four gates green.** A task whose transcript differs in a way this document does not name is not delivered.

**Task 2 is done in etalii-adp/etalii.adp**, through that repository's own pull request. Task 4 cannot start before it is merged there.

---

## The coverage diff, run before this document was raised

**52 acceptance criteria in the requirements; 52 claimed by the tasks below; none unclaimed, and nothing claimed that is not a criterion.**

| Requirement | Criteria | Claimed by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 4 | 1 (1.1, 1.2, 1.3), 7 (1.4) |
| 2 | 5 | 2 (2.1, 2.2, 2.3), 4 (2.4, 2.5) |
| 3 | 5 | 5 (3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.5), 6 (3.3) |
| 4 | 6 | 6 (4.1 to 4.6) |
| 5 | 9 | 7 (5.1 to 5.8), 8 (5.9) |
| 6 | 3 | 6 (6.1), 7 (6.2, 6.3) |
| 7 | 4 | 7 (7.2), 10 (7.1, 7.3, 7.4) |
| 8 | 4 | 9 (8.1 to 8.4) |
| 9 | 4 | 3 (9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4) |
| 10 | 4 | 2 (10.2), 10 (10.1, 10.3, 10.4) |
| 11 | 4 | 4 (11.3), 10 (11.1, 11.2, 11.4) |

**The diff is run again at task 10**, traced to the tests, files and strings the work produced and not to a task's promise, and two traces are read back to their artefacts to check that the evidence is that criterion's and not a neighbour's.

---

## The tasks

- [ ] 1. Freeze the parity transcript from today's code
  - Files: `src/diagrams/causal-loop-diagram/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.CausalLoopDiagram.Tests/Parity/CausalLoopTranscript.cs`, `Parity/CausalLoopTranscript.Tests.cs`, `Parity/TranscriptText.cs`, `Parity/causal-loop.transcript.json`, `Fixtures/*.cld` (new), `.gitattributes` only if a new fixture needs an attribute `.cld` does not have
  - Write the generator in the shape of the timeline's: per document the menus (every element id, the canvas, a placement, a connect gesture, an unknown id), the rows, the findings, the payloads, and a scripted edit sequence running every command once, with each step's answer and the hunks it made.
  - The corpus: the module's `examples/`, the copies under `src/examples/diagrams/causal-loop-diagram/`, and one new fixture per finding of table B and A7 marked Read: `lenient-spellings.cld`, `dangling-link.cld`, `duplicate-variable.cld`, `no-header.cld`, `header-twice.cld`, `trailing-comments.cld`, `weight-forms.cld`, `two-notes.cld`, `label-with-quote.cld`, `spellings-kept.cld`.
  - For each Read finding, say in the pull request whether the transcript shows it. One that does not occur is struck from the requirements as a small amendment, through the Scrum master.
  - See the test fail once against a deliberately changed sentence in a provider, restore, touch the file, and record the failure in the implementation log.
  - No product code changes.
  - _Leverage: `src/diagrams/timeline/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.Timeline.Tests/Parity/`, `src/diagrams/gartner-hype-cycle-graph/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.GartnerHypeCycleGraph.Tests/Parity/`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec causal-loop-disl-fbl, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend developer who writes characterization tests | Task: Freeze what the causal loop module answers today as Parity/causal-loop.transcript.json, with a generator and a byte-for-byte test, over the examples and one new fixture per Read finding of the requirements | Restrictions: Change no product code; do not shape a fixture so that a finding disappears; mask nothing unless it is nondeterministic and say why; CRLF house rules apply and `.cld` is byte-compared | _Leverage: the timeline's and the hype cycle's Parity folders | _Requirements: 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 | Success: the test reproduces the checked-in transcript, was seen to fail against a changed sentence, every Read finding is shown or reported as not occurring, four gates exit zero | Instructions: set this task to [-] in tasks.md before starting, log the work with log-implementation when done, then set it to [x]._

- [ ] 2. Rewrite the definition at DISL 0.3, in etalii-adp/etalii.adp
  - Files (in etalii.adp): `definitions/diagrams/causal-loop-diagram.dis`, `definitions/diagrams/causal-loop-diagram.md`, `specifications/fbl/causal-loop-diagram.fbl`
  - Replace each workaround finding A2 lists by its DISL 0.2 or 0.3 construct; `routing: "curved"` (A3); `persistence.format: "fbl"` with `binding`, `ids` with a `prefix` per type, and the `typeMap` of the design (A4, B3); the `x-cld` wire-id block (A5); `std.duplicateId` switched off (A7, Q4).
  - Rewrite the companion: what DISL 0.3 cannot express (A8 to A11), the seven gaps of section C with their evidence, and nothing 0.3 can express.
  - Bring the example binding in line with the module's binding as the requirements' appendix drafts it, so the `cld` divergences can go when it is vendored again.
  - State nothing in the definition that the tool does not do: every sentence, label and code is copied from the transcript of task 1.
  - _Leverage: `definitions/diagrams/gartner-hype-cycle-graph.dis` for `typeMap`, `x-ghg`, `unavailable`, `constraints.order`; DISL *Changes from 0.1* and *Changes from 0.2*_
  - _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 10.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec causal-loop-disl-fbl, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Tool engineer fluent in DISL 0.3 and FBL 0.2 | Task: In etalii-adp/etalii.adp rewrite the causal loop definition at DISL 0.3 with FBL persistence, a typeMap and an x-cld block, rewrite its companion, and align the example binding | Restrictions: Follow that repository's CLAUDE.md, branch and pull request rules and its schema and terminology checks; state only what the standalone transcript shows the tool doing; do not close a gap by stating something untrue | _Leverage: the hype cycle definition; the requirements' two appendices; the transcript of task 1 | _Requirements: 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 10.2 | Success: the definition validates against the DISL schema, the binding against the FBL schema, the repository's checks pass, the pull request is merged | Instructions: set this task to [-] in tasks.md before starting, log the work with log-implementation when done, then set it to [x]._

- [ ] 3. Library work: cycles, the CEL helpers, and what the derivations lack

  - Start by loading the definition of task 2 with `DislLoader` in a scratch test and listing every function and construct it refuses; that list replaces the design's L1 to L4 where they differ, and is put in the pull request.
  - L1: `diagram.cycles(relType, max)` and `diagram.cyclesTruncated(relType, max)` as DISL 12.4 defines them, with tests for a self-loop, two cycles sharing a member, the bound and the order.
  - L2 to L4: each missing CEL helper, each missing `forEach` or `drop.targets` support, one test class each.
  - Every test is seen to fail before its change. No module name appears in the libraries. `EtAlii.Adp.Specification.Fbl` is not changed unless a fixture of task 1 shows a defect in it, which is then its own commit with its own failing test.
  - _Leverage: the module's `CycleFinder.cs` for Johnson's algorithm; `EtAlii.Adp.Specification.Disl.Tests`_
  - _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec causal-loop-disl-fbl, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Library developer on EtAlii.Adp.Specification.Disl | Task: Add diagram.cycles and cyclesTruncated per DISL 12.4, the CEL helpers and the derivation support the rewritten causal loop definition needs, confirmed by loading it first | Restrictions: Name nothing for the causal loop; add only what the loader's refusals show is missing; each test seen to fail first; no blocking call in an async method; pass TestContext.Current.CancellationToken | _Leverage: CycleFinder.cs; the existing Disl tests | _Requirements: 9.1, 9.2, 9.3, 9.4 | Success: the rewritten definition loads with no error diagnostic, every added function has a failing-first test, four gates exit zero | Instructions: set this task to [-] in tasks.md before starting, log the work with log-implementation when done, then set it to [x]._

- [ ] 4. Bundle the definition and hold it
  - Files: `src/diagrams/causal-loop-diagram/definition/causal-loop-diagram.dis`, `.md`, `provenance.json`, `backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.CausalLoopDiagram/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.CausalLoopDiagram.csproj`, `backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.CausalLoopDiagram.Tests/BundledDefinition.Tests.cs`, `src/diagrams/readme.md`
  - Run `bash src/diagrams/tools/bundle-disl.sh causal-loop-diagram <etalii.adp checkout>`; embed the `.dis`; add the test that the embedded bytes equal `definition/`, that the sha256 holds and that the definition loads with no error.
  - Build a newly created worktree before trusting the gates, because this task changes what is embedded.
  - Nothing derives from the definition yet; the transcript is unchanged.
  - _Leverage: `src/diagrams/timeline/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.Timeline.Tests/BundledDefinition.Tests.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 2.4, 2.5, 11.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec causal-loop-disl-fbl, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend developer | Task: Bundle the causal loop definition with bundle-disl.sh, embed it and add BundledDefinition.Tests | Restrictions: Never edit a bundled file by hand; judge every gate by a captured exit code; build a fresh worktree before trusting green | _Leverage: the timeline's BundledDefinition.Tests | _Requirements: 2.4, 2.5, 11.3 | Success: the bundled definition loads with no error, the transcript test is unchanged and green, four gates exit zero in a fresh worktree | Instructions: set this task to [-] in tasks.md before starting, log the work with log-implementation when done, then set it to [x]._

  - The DISL model is built at this task from `CausalLoopParser`'s reading through a small adapter, so derivation changes and reading does not. The adapter is deleted in task 6.
  - Move the providers' logic to `HandWrittenCausalLoop` in the test project as the oracle, and compare derived with hand-written per document and element.
  - Every sentence of Requirement 3.2 is read unchanged; the transcript's menus, rows and payloads are byte-identical.
  - _Leverage: `GhgDefinition.cs`, `TimelineDisl.cs` for a model built from a module's own reader, the hype cycle's `Parity/GhgDerivedMenus.Tests.cs` and `GhgDerivedRows.Tests.cs`_
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec causal-loop-disl-fbl, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Backend developer who knows the DISL derivations | Task: Add CausalLoopDefinition and make the three providers hand out the derived toolbox, menus and rows, with the hand-written logic kept in the test project as the oracle | Restrictions: Do not change how the body is read or written in this task; do not regenerate the transcript; a difference is a defect in the definition (fix it in etalii.adp and bundle again) or in the library, never papered over in the provider | _Leverage: GhgDefinition.cs; TimelineDisl.cs; the hype cycle's Parity tests | _Requirements: 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.5 | Success: the transcript is reproduced byte for byte, derived equals hand-written for every document, the providers hold no logic, four gates exit zero | Instructions: set this task to [-] in tasks.md before starting, log the work with log-implementation when done, then set it to [x]._

  - Files: `backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.CausalLoopDiagram/Commands/*.cs`, `Commands/CausalLoopEdits.cs`, `CausalLoopDefinition.cs` (`Apply`), `CausalLoopParser.cs` and `CausalLoopWriter.cs` (removed from the product, what the oracle needs moved to the test project), `CausalLoopSession.cs`, `Parity/causal-loop.transcript.json` (edit hunks regenerated), `Parity/CausalLoopDerivedOperations.Tests.cs`

A move and Arrange diagram still write the registration through core's `SetRegistrationLayoutCommand` and `RegistrationLayout`, each one undo step, and a document without a registration refuses them with today's sentences.
